title: result.json of an agent run
description: How a role ended (<item>/agents/<agent_run_id>/result.json, agents.py finish), however it ended. A role closed on resume after the conductor died has only error ORPHANED (agents.py orphan): nothing else is invented. Exactly one of the two variants: an empty or tag-only document is no result.

oneOf.description: A finished agent run (agents.finish): every field of its end, error only when it failed.
An agent run closed on resume (agents.orphan): only the error ORPHANED.

not.description: No field of a finished run.

exit.description: Exit code of the last process, null when none ended.

decisions.description: Decisions of retry.decide after failures at the provider, in order.

duration_s.description: Wall time of the agent run.

stream.description: Stream of the last attempt, relative to the project; null when none.

lingered.description: The process lingered after its result and was stopped.

error.description: An error/v1 document when the failure was classified, else {code, message} of the stop.

action.description: Action decided (retry, wait, fallback, reconcile, stop).
